project.title: SARS-CoV-2 sequencing in Slovak wastewaters
project.description: Collected genomic RNA samples from wastewater treatment plants in Slovakia over nine months in 2022 to assess the effectiveness of wastewater-based epidemiology in monitoring community variant prevalence.
